literal_meaning: কত (how many) + যে (that/which) – exclamatory expression for quantity
figurative_meaning_en: Indicating abundance or excess in number
example_sentences_in_english: How many flowers have bloomed in the garden!
How many people have come to the fair.
history: Derived from Rabindranath Tagore's poetic line: 'কত যে গিরি কত যে নদীতীরে কত যে তান বাজালে ফিরে ফিরে', evoking vastness in nature and emotion.
note: Often used in literary contexts to express wonder at multiplicity.
